 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• The word **"crawled"** means to move forward on the hands and knees or by dragging the body close to the ground. (रेंगना)

 
 
• **Example: **The baby** crawled **across the floor to reach his toys.
 
• **Example:** Each time she fell to her knees and **crawled** instead.
 
• **Example:** I watched as a tiny little puppy **crawled** out from under the bed.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct option to fill in blank no. 2 is **"crawled"**.

Therefore, the correct statement is 'and undressed and **crawled **into bed....'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Gnawed **(कुतरना): To bite at or nibble something persistently.

 
 
• **Example:** The dog **gnawed** on the bone for hours.
 
 
 
• **Lurched **(झटके से हिलना): To make an abrupt, unsteady, uncontrolled movement or series of movements.
 
 
• **Example:** The boat** lurched** in the stormy sea.
 
 
 
• **Peeped** (झांकना): To look quickly and furtively at something, especially through a narrow opening.
 
 
• **Example:** He** peeped** into the room to see if anyone was there.
